name: Siphon foam
summary: A purée or a liquid loaded into a cream siphon with nitrous oxide comes out as a light, warm or cold foam.
how: Strain the liquid or purée so that no solid blocks the nozzle.
Fill the siphon to half and charge it with one cartridge of nitrous oxide.
Shake the siphon five times and serve at once from the nozzle.
Keep a hot foam at 60 °C in a water bath.

origin.note: Ferran Adrià took the cream siphon of the pastry kitchen to make savoury foams at elBulli.

adoptions.via: Modernist Cuisine gave tested foam recipes, and modernist kitchens used the siphon for sauces and soups.
